- **Magic Albums sees your whole library (FL-1306):** the review now lists all your albums, including ones inside collections, albums you also use in Boards, partner albums and albums shared with you. Only smart albums are left out.
- **Your collections stay as you arranged them (FL-1306):** albums already in a collection can have duplicates beside them merged and lost dates fixed, and they stay where they are. Partner albums, albums shared with you and collections are listed but never changed.
